name: cat_parity
description: count category members in first 3 of 6
probe_label_space: PARITY of the count (0/1) — the count itself is an additive sum and fails the additive-threshold rule
basis_kind: the first-3 word set (3 shared components over the member+distractor vocab)
composability: parity's mod-2 wrap is not expressible by additive per-word membership scores
